text:
Marta (People Ops): Omar in Zurich flagged his July paystub 	1: shows Swiss AHV/ALV contributions AND US FICA withholding for the same earnings. Can payroll + mobility check? Pay period 2026-07-01 to 2026-07-31.

Paystub snippet:
```text
Gross: CHF 10,300
AHV/IV/ALV (Swiss social): CHF 1,120
US FICA: USD 420
Net: CHF 7,980 (converted)
```
Link to stub: <https://payroll.redwood/secure/stubs/OmarS/2026-07>

Omar S.: I relocated to Zurich on 2026-06-28 on a Swiss local contract per offer. Mobility confirmed Swiss onboarding and social registration. I uploaded my Swiss AHV number and residence permit. I definitely shouldn't be paying FICA.

Jin (Payroll): Please send Payrun ID and GID. Need to see whether country switch occurred before cutoff and whether legacy US tax flag remained active.

Helena (Payroll Ops): PR-20260731-15, GID RWF-9122. Employee record country set to CH on 2026-06-30 but export file to the US tax engine included element `FICA_US` because `retain_us_tax_flag=true` remained on the benefits profile. Looks like benefits/deferrals mapping caused tax engine to include FICA.

payroll-bot: Ticket #PAY-14077 created: "Omar S - FICA withheld on Swiss payroll". Assigned to Helena. <https://payroll.redwood/tickets/PAY-14077>

Rita (Global Mobility): Mobility docs show Omar's Swiss employment effective 2026-06-29 and AHV registration confirmed 2026-07-02. He meets the local registration dates. I'll attach the AHV confirmation and residence permit to the ticket.

Tom (Tax): Two immediate notes: 1) For Switzerland, local AHV/ALV contributions are statutory and should apply; FICA should not apply for Swiss local hires unless there's a specific totalization agreement exception. The US-Switzerland Totalization Agreement generally prevents dual social security taxation when covered by Swiss system. 2) We should reverse FICA and refund Omar; employer-side FICA employer portion should also be reversed. If reversal is after W-2 issuance, W-2c will be necessary.

Omar S.: Will I need to file anything in the US because FICA was withheld? I'm a US citizen but living/working in Switzerland now.

Tom (Tax): Generally, the withheld FICA will be refundable via payroll reversal; you should keep copies of the AHV confirmation. For US tax filing, you'll still file a US return as a citizen, but the social security withholding reversal means no FICA paid. We'll provide guidance but not tax advice; recommend you consult your personal tax advisor if you have questions about foreign earned income exclusion or social security credits.

Helena (Payroll Ops): Proposed actions: 1) Reverse `FICA_US` and any related employer FICA lines in PR-20260731-15, post a net adjustment to correct Omar's July net pay. 2) If 401(k) deferral was accidentally triggered by the US flag, coordinate with retirement vendor to unwind any deferrals. 3) Prepare employer reclaim paperwork if Swiss authorities require employer-side proof for retro refund. ETA: reversals and net fix targeted by next payroll cycle (08/15).

Jin (Payroll): Once reversals posted, send GL journals to payroll-recon so month close can be adjusted. Also check whether state/local US withholdings were included by mistake (rare for CH but check).

Rita (Global Mobility): I'll upload AHV confirmation + residence permit to PAY-14077 and contact our Zurich ER rep to confirm local reclaim procedure if Swiss had employer payments.

payroll-bot: PAY-14077 status -> "in progress" (assigned: Helena).

Marta (People Ops): Omar, we'll DM timing once Helena posts the reversal. Helena 	 please include expected amounts and whether Omar needs to sign any consent forms for vendor refunds. Tom, if payroll can't reverse before W-2 prep we'll plan for W-2c process.

Tom (Tax): Agreed. Also check Social Security totalization exceptions: if someone is temporarily sent from US payroll to CH and remains covered by US SS, there are exceptions; in Omar's case mobility confirms local contract so Swiss coverage is correct. I'll review and confirm.

Helena (Payroll Ops): Noted. I'll confirm whether any 401(k) deferral posted and open vendor ticket if so. I'll post a status update to PAY-14077 after reversals.

Omar S.: Thanks all 5 appreciate the quick look. Happy to provide any extra proof needed.

Marta (People Ops): Summary/action owners: Helena 	 reverse FICA + employer lines, net correction + vendor contact; Jin 	 reconcile journals; Rita 	 upload mobility docs + ER contact; Tom 	 confirm totalization stance and W-2c need. We'll update Omar by 08/05.
